Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas. I was going through on a green light, heading straight.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?
A: Not really. It came from my right side and I only saw it a split second before it hit my driver's side door.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were traveling?
A: Maybe around the posted limit, something like that. I wasn't rushing.
Q: Were there any witnesses you're aware of?
A: A man in a pickup stopped afterward and asked if I was okay. I didn't get his contact information.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, the paramedics checked me at the scene, and I went to urgent care later that day.
Q: What injuries are you reporting?
A: My right knee. It hit the steering column and the door frame. It's swollen, and bending it hurts, esepcially on stairs.
Q: Has a doctor diagnosed anything specific yet?
A: They ordered an MRI and told me to follow up with an orthopedist. I'm still waiting on the results.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Only that I was following the signals and I believe the other driver ran the red light. That's my honest recollection.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
